text: MARK ANTONETZ ANNETTE MCMURRY RENEE VAUGHAN BOARD OF TRUSTEES PATRICK MYERS FISCAL OFFICER BOARD OF TRUSTEES SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA DECEMBER 8, 2026 – 5:30 PM CALL TO ORDER ROLL CALL This meeting of the Genoa Township Trustees will be recorded.
